mode: built-in image_gen; whole generated RGB, never original-center RGB compositing

nativeForegroundCleanPlate.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, object removal clean plate. Edit supplied1366x768 nightclub room background. REMOVE the ENTIRE central DJ booth including all desk equipment, counter top, frontal box, cords/cables draped on it, lower polygonal raised platform and its front fascia; also remove their cast shadows. Fill the vacated area with a natural CONTINUOUS flat tiled dance floor below and black glitter room back wall above, carrying the same white/green straight laser beams naturally across wall. The floor is uninterrupted single level, no podium, stairs, platforms, furniture or remnants. Preserve the camera, exact framing/vertical field of view, all surrounding walls, ceiling/floor grid perspective, left speaker and upper right spotlight, lighting/palette, early2000s CGI style. No people or new props. Preserve all existing frame outside former booth area as much as possible. The game will render the actual booth separately afterward, so this image must contain ZERO booth, equipment or platform. Output a complete opaque16:9 clean plate, no borders.
nativeForegroundCleanPlate.reason: Original model renders booth and platform. Background must not contain a duplicate.

cameraRegistration.method: SIFT/RANSAC homography of generated RGB only; original reference used for coordinates, never RGB compositing
cameraRegistration.qualityCheck: Compare native camera landmarks and foreground occluders, inspect all borders. Fewer matches need manual review.

borderRepair.prompt: Edit only the empty masked edge of the supplied already generated game background. Continue the same architecture, floor perspective, lighting and early-2000s prerendered style. Preserve existing framing and interior geometry. Do not add people, props, pipes, signage, borders or text. Produce one complete opaque 16:9 frame. The original game image is not a pixel-compositing source.
borderRepair.composition: Keep registered generated interior; apply newly generated RGB only to missing border plus a small feather. Save actual prompt, target/mask/output hashes and registration matrix with incoming PNG.

validation: Render the real scene with original foreground props. Successful scene loading alone does not establish visual alignment.
